annual_discount_text: Core: a 25% savings with annual billing; Advanced: a 6% savings with annual billing
notes: Only one view (as the page loads) was provided. Core and Advanced prices come from the FAQ and are described as starting prices per license that may exclude VAT/GST and promotional discounts. Non-USD localized prices not recorded: Core A$154.99/month or A$1,499.88/year, C$144.99/month or C$1,199.88/year, EUR 120.99/month or EUR 1,088.88/year, GBP 94.99/month or GBP 959.88/year; Advanced A$189.99/month or A$2,159.88/year, C$179.99/month or C$2,039.88/year, EUR 148.21/month or EUR 1,693.88/year, GBP 130.00/month or GBP 1,499.88/year. Advanced Plus pricing is customized based on team size, CRM integration and onboarding needs; available via demo request or sales contact. Advanced licenses can be bought online up to five. Free trials are offered for Core and Advanced and require a credit card. InMail 50/month is a feature, not a price. Team seat management is listed as a feature, with no credits mentioned.
